limitations: Command voltage, controller telemetry and multimeter measurements are distinct. No factory-voltage, universal gain or compensation offset was inferred.
Only the MP2888A manual command/mode path was physically qualified. Other controller families remain unported.
The native GUI buttons are covered by injected ImGui interaction tests; hardware writes used the interactive helper calling the same native Client/Session services.

The live helper was rebuilt after testing; the original helper executable hash was not captured. Subsequent changes added route intent guards, cached UI eligibility, software slider bounds and presentation tests; the transport and register write algorithm were unchanged.
x86 NVAPI Ex packet acceptance and Vista/7 execution remain unqualified. x86 refuses this I2C operation without disabling unrelated core functionality.

verification.apply_header_collision: Actual heading hover and click with ImGui diagnostics enabled: zero ID conflicts; heading does not queue a hardware command
verification.i2c_buttons: Probe, route-bound gate/Verify/Apply/Release, disabled states, no command on render/hover, and disconnected recovery tested in both presentations
verification.live_window_smoke: All 11 read-only phases passed; explicit Pause and ordinary minimization produced zero frames and telemetry reads; Always refresh minimized produced 114 frames and 2 telemetry reads
verification.visuals: Classic and Focused D3D9 captures reviewed; Classic advanced readback marked configured, memory retains explicit driver units
verification.import_audit: Passed bounded UI PE/import audit; not proof of Vista/7 launch or complete API floor
